Moves SKR out of your wallet into the staking vault and credits it to your own staking account. You can start unstaking it again whenever you like.
Starts unstaking. No SKR reaches your wallet now: these tokens stop earning, wait out a cooldown, and then have to be withdrawn in a second, separate approval.
Puts the whole pending unstake back to work as active stake and clears its cooldown. No SKR moves.
Moves the SKR whose cooldown has finished out of the vault and back into your wallet. This is the step that actually returns the tokens.

A cooldown is already running. Unstaking more restarts it, so SKR you were close to withdrawing waits the full cooldown again.
